lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines of varying thickness traversing the torso from shoulder to rump; spacing is narrowest at the anterior and posterior extremes and widest across the mid-lateral barrel.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Partial Y-shaped bifurcation visible at the ventral terminus of the third vertical line from the cranial end.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second cranial vertical line is a shortened segment; several lines on the posterior torso terminate mid-mass before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower flank align horizontally to form a dashed linear boundary parallel to the ventral torso line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal marking on the lower neck/chest region and distinct white circular spots on the carpal joints of the forelimbs.
